newsitem.title: USA: ABC to name new entertainment head -Variety.
newsitem.headline: ABC to name new entertainment head -Variety.

text.p: ABC executive Stuart Bloomberg is expected to be named chairman of ABC Entertainment, edging out ABC Entertainment President Jamie Tarses who had been denying rumors of Bloomberg's appointment, Daily Variety said in Tuesday's edition.

ABC television, a unit of Walt Disney Co, and Tarses declined to comment on Monday. However, as recently as Friday, Tarses said top ABC executives had assured her that Bloomberg was not getting the post.
Unnamed sources told Variety that ABC President Robert Iger flew to Los Angeles and broke the news to Tarses on Monday.
Bloomberg, currently president of TV creative services at ABC, had been a top development executive at the network when Iger was entertainment president.
